::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 10th 1881  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

Dear Madam

I should like much to get your [Christmas tree paper](other_books/otherbook_948.qmd)[^1] in for December, and I will try, but it must depend on the reckoning of pages by the printer

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: 'A Christmas Tree at a Workhouse' *MP* 3rd series 2 (December 1881) 609-612.
